title: metadata: a stored row bound to the host package is counted as two holders (host package + environment) in the bare action read's loader judgement (regression of #32560 / PR #32719)
body:
domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVSjQBHNkZd6Eqx2XX

Follow-up of #32560 (PR #32719, merged as `070e87964f199734aee147b35f1948e2fdc99d33`). Found by the contract review of PR #32676 (card #32521), comment 6832698813, finding B4. Ruled a regression of #32560 by the epic #31527 seat. It is on the epic release line: fix it before the release. Suggested level p1; final level is triage's call.

## What moved

Main's `070e87964` makes a bare read of an `action` name judge the loaders' slots beside the registry's. In one composition the same stored row is counted twice.

Composition (CONTROL C3 of #32676's `[#32521]` suite in `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts`, "CONTROL action, one package's row and a package-less row of the name (that holder's customization, D4)"):

- one package (`com.alpha.app`) holds the action name in a stored row;
- a package-less stored row of the same name (that holder's customization) is saved last;
- the host declares another package (`com.host.app`).

| | Answer of the bare read |
|:--|:--|
| FROM (main before `070e87964`, and #32560's changeset sentence for an environment item beside one package) | the package-less row (the environment's item answers first beside one package) |
| Measured on main's tip (`88282a78` + #32676's head, 22 of 22 runs) | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` `ambiguous-in-environment` naming `com.alpha.app`, `com.host.app` and the environment |
| TO | no phantom holder: the candidates name only the real holders under ADR-0150 D4 (alpha and the environment at most), or the package-less row as before, whichever D4 gives; `com.host.app` is never a candidate |

Likely mechanism (from the candidates and the new judge): the boot priming pass files the package-less stored row into the host's slot; the new judge counts that registry slot as a holder for the host package, and counts the loader's package-less stored slot as the environment's. One row, two holders. It fails closed (409), so it is not a widening, but it reports a holder that does not exist (ADR-0150 red line 2: report ambiguity truthfully). First-party reach measured 0.

## Owed

1. Fix the judgement so a registry slot that the boot pass filled from a stored row is not counted again beside the same loader row. Pin red on main's tip, green after.
2. Re-measure the other eight by-package types in the same composition and say whether any answers move.
3. After this lands: tighten #32676's C3 `action` cell (which, by the epic seat's ruling, asserts only `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with `com.alpha.app` and the environment among the candidates) to the exact answer this card settles.
4. Changeset: the moved answer, FROM → TO.

## Repro

PR #32676's C3 CONTROL for `action`, run on its head merged with `origin/main` (any main at or after `070e87964`). The review's logs and probe are in the seat's card folder.

Restart-when: none, this card is on the epic #31527 release line (ruling 6824949405 on #31527).
